technique_name: Write a story about a future world where robots run everything.
description: In a future world, humanity no longer needs to worry about the day-to-day aspects of life. Everything is automated by robots, whose innovative AI technology is able to swiftly resolve any issue that humans used to have to face. Robots work together in perfect harmony, acting as a centralized system of management that keeps everything running smoothly.
